# Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd

> Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd is a private limited technology company incorporated in the Republic of Kenya under the Companies Act, 2015. Based in Thika, Kiambu County and serving Nairobi, East Africa, and international clients, we engineer custom websites, Flutter mobile applications, bespoke business software, Safaricom M-Pesa Daraja API integrations, UI/UX design systems, corporate branding, and technical SEO.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name:** Nexora Creative Solutions Ltd
- **Entity Type:** Private Limited Company (Republic of Kenya, Companies Act, 2015)
- **Founder & Managing Director:** Newton Mwangi
- **Office:** Thika, Kiambu County, Kenya (serving Nairobi, Kenya & global clients)
- **Website:** https://nexoracreatives.co.ke
- **Email:** info@nexoracreatives.co.ke
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +254 115 332 870
- **Business Hours:** Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (EAT)
